top_signal.title: Jewelry Business scaling
top_signal.summary: my situation:  I have a small jewelry business in my town and it's running better and better. I started in January/February making gifts for my friends, and since April I've been selling at markets, which happen roughly twice every three months. (I’ll unfortunately miss christmas markets)   Quite a few people in my city already know me and my name. Some even come to the market just to get my jewelry. I also sold at a market in a different city, and that worked well too.    my problem:   How do I scale and make money besides markets? Or should I expand more to markets in other cities?   Selling online isn't working well so far. I might be a bit lazy about it because the markets are going so well, and I don't have enough reach on social media yet. I probably need to push that more.    Workshops to scale?   Some people asked about workshops, so I already did a first one with 5 people in my garage. They were quite happy in the end. There's also a girl in town offering workshops and hers are fully booked (she makes very different jewelry). And i would be able to do the workshop most likely in a hip cafe / bar in town!   Do you have other ideas on how to scale, or how to go on from here? Should I push it more?  I don't rely on the money, it's a nice addition. But this weekend at a market, for example, I made nearly my monthly salary, and I've really started to love selling handmade physical products and tbh. thinking about quitting my job to go more into this tbh.   thanks for your
